package.name: data_collection
package.description:
Scripted demonstrations for the OMX follower: run the expert, record what it did.
Everything happens over omx_bridge_image's public interface -- commands go out on /sync/command, the twin's state comes back on the profile's sim endpoint, and the cube is read and moved through Isaac's own prim services. An episode therefore needs no Isaac-side scripting: open the scene, press Play, ros2 run.
The kinematics, the config loader and the spawn sampler live in omx_vla_app because eval.py needs the same ones -- an evaluation that measures something other than what was demonstrated measures nothing.
